_comment: License (TRIAL_FIRST 先用后付) client-software product under the QUOTA billing model (按量额度): sell quota packs — each licenseEditions row is a pack with quotaAmount (次数) + billingPeriod (有效期); buying again ADDs quota to the remaining balance (可累加), there is NO upgrade price-difference deduction (licenseDeductionEnabled is forced off server-side). Trial dimension is COUNT-based here: per-edition trialCount (+ optional trialCountPeriod TOTAL|MONTHLY); trialDays is NOT required under QUOTA (omit it — TRIAL_FIRST still needs licenseEnabled+licensePlatformPayment+≥1 edition). Under the default EDITION model (版本分层) trials are day-based (trialDays) and trialCount is ignored.

baseInfo.summary: A license-gated desktop app sold as quota packs: buy 20/100/500 credits, use them anytime, top up when used up — credits stack.

licenseEditions.name: Standard
licenseEditions.description: 100 credits, never expire — the popular pack.

introduce.functions: Batch image enhancement, style presets, local-first processing, and a credit meter wired to the PowerSoftware license quota.
introduce.targetUserGroup: Designers and content teams who pay for usage rather than a seat license.
introduce.usageScenarios: Occasional bulk enhancement jobs where a monthly subscription would be wasted.
introduce.painPoints: Subscriptions charge for idle months; one-off keys don't scale with usage.
